observations: Photo 0 shows a handheld manual air pump with a blue barrel and a white handle/nozzle end.
A hose/cord with a small red connector is visible near the pump body.
No brand name, model number, or specifications are readable in the photo.
No clear view of the pump head/valve type, pressure gauge, or any included adapters.

claims.claim: Air Pump-requires minimum effort and within a few strokes air gets inflated
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show performance, flow rate, or whether it inflates quickly.
The seller text is incomplete and the photo does not provide weight or material details.

risks.risk: Pump may not hold pressure (leaks at seals/valve) or may not inflate to usable pressure.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video inflating a ball/tyre from empty to firm, showing it stays inflated after 10–15 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a manual pump that may be weak/leaky (worst case: not reliably inflating).

risks.risk: Wrong nozzle/adapter for the buyer’s intended use (ball, tyre, inflatable mattress, etc.).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the exact nozzle/valve tip and a list/photo of included adapters; also show it connected to the intended item.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a pump with unknown compatibility (worst case: needs extra parts).

risks.risk: Condition issues (worn seals, cracked plastic, bent stem) that reduce performance.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the pump head/valve area and the hose/connector, plus any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst case: reduced performance).

proof_requests: Video: inflate a common item (ball or small tyre) from near-empty to firm, then show it after 10–15 minutes.
Close-up photos of the pump head/valve and the red connector/hose end.
Photo of all included adapters/nozzles and confirmation of what it fits (ball/tyre/mattress).
response.reason: From photo 0 it’s a handheld manual air pump, but the key value drivers (leaks/pressure holding, compatibility, and actual inflation performance) can’t be confirmed remotely. Proof is needed before pricing confidently.
